say:0:1012711001:0.text: Why does Lorsan suddenly want to return to the Vaduso Mountains?
say:0:1012711001:0.source_cn: 洛桑为什么突然想回瓦度索山脉？那么远。
say:0:1012711001:0.male: Why does Lorsan suddenly want to return to the Vaduso Mountains?
say:0:1012711001:0.female: Why does Lorsan suddenly want to return to the Vaduso Mountains?

say:1:1012711002:0.text: I'm not sure. He's always had some strange ideas.
say:1:1012711002:0.source_cn: 不太清楚，他总是有些奇怪的点子。
